notes: Catch-up recordings: when a catch-up save has to ask the provider again for the part it missed, the request now reaches the end of the program instead of stopping a minute short. A catch-up the provider refuses to continue is saved as a partial recording instead of staying 'recovering' forever (which could also hold a recording slot and delay scheduled recordings), and a save waiting for a busy provider slot gives up after 2 hours and keeps what it has. Watching a recording in progress: the server now answers a seek right away instead of holding its reply until more video arrives. Reliability: an internal error during a guide refresh can no longer freeze scheduled recordings, and the recording index stays accurate when a finished file part can't be checked. Includes all earlier fixes.
